Assessment Booklet for Teachers
 Remedial Reading Programme
 Remedial Reading Assessment Booklet for Teachers
Teacher Name: TSC Number:
 Assessment tools (Kiswahili and English) : 3 samples each
 Contents of this booklet: Assessment data recording sheets: for baseline and endline
 Attendance and progression sheets
Instructions for the Assessment Data Recording Sheet
This sheet should be filled by teachers during assessments. Use a different sheet for every grade. Any learner who comes after the baseline totals are
completed, add his/her name in the sheet, assess him/her for grouping, but don't record the baseline result in this sheet. Record his/her data for midline and
endline as you do for other learners.
How to cross check the results:
a) Check that you have marked every learner on each competency (Kiswahili and English)
b) Check the totals.
 - Number of total tested learners should be equal to the sum of Beginner, Letter, Word, Paragraph and Story level (in Kiswahili) Learners.
- Sum of Can and Cannot for each comprehension question should be equal to sum total of learners at Story level.
- Number of total tested learners should be equal to the sum of Beginner, Letter, Word, Paragraph, and Story level (in English) Learners.
- Sum of Can and Cannot under comprehension in English should be equal to sum total of learners at Storylevel.
Tool sample number: During each assessment cycle, rotate samples for different Learners. For example, use sample 1 for learner 1, sample 2 for learner 2 and
so on. For a learner, use different sample numbers for different rounds of assessments. For example, if you used sample 1 during baseline, use sample 2 for
midline and sample 3 for endline.
